contea di ritrovamento: Norfolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragment of Samien ware dating to the Roman period (45-410AD). The fragment is from the centre of the base of a vessel. It is sub-circular circular in plan and has a raised side which expands up and outwards from the base of the fragment.
